title: Distributed Quantum Optimization for Large-Scale Higher-Order Problems with Dense Interactions
summary: Many real-world problems are naturally formulated as higher-order optimization (HUBO) tasks involving dense, multi-variable interactions, which are challenging to solve with classical methods. Quantum optimization offers a promising route, but hardware constraints and limitations to quadratic formulations have hampered their practicality. Here, we develop a distributed quantum optimization framework (DQOF) for dense, large-scale HUBO problems.
